name: Street Rod Main Street
description: Street Rod's town round Main Street: about five blocks by five where the racers meet at the four diners, each at a place of its own, and the private sellers show their cars, laid out with Street Rod's street kit (shops, houses, cars at the curbs, palms, lamp posts, signs), with the street's and the diners' sounds.
